quest.title: Investigate the Fatui Camps Marked by Sosi
quest.description: According to Sosi, some uninvited guests seem to be coveting the divine powers of the monument. You might have to defeat their officer in order to drive them away...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Hey, you scheming humans! I suggest leaving this place at once — the heritage and secrets of us Pari are not for you to covet, and certainly not within your reach.

dialogues.speaker: Markozov
dialogues.text: ...Pari? You're a Pari! Oh, what an amazing experience!

dialogues.speaker: Markozov
dialogues.text: #Oh! And there's also a {M#wiry young man}{F#little young lady} with {M#his}{F#her}... pet?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, watch what you say! Paimon's {M#his}{F#her} best friend!

dialogues.speaker: Markozov
dialogues.text: Friend... Why, of course! "Best friend"... What a beautiful sound! I've always wanted to have a "best friend" since childhood...

dialogues.speaker: Markozov
dialogues.text: #{M#Wiry young man}{F#Little young lady}, you're certainly not in need of two best friends, are you?

response.speaker: Markozov
response.text: I mean... Even if you're the one having two best friends, don't you think it's a little unfair?

response.speaker: Markozov
response.text: Inequities like this are impossible to forgive... So please, hand the Pari over to me. As for how I'll treat it... you wouldn't have to worry. I'll make sure it's used to its full potential.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, he's being so unreasonable... There's no getting through to him!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: We can always make him understand without wasting our words... My clever Yasnapati, surely you know what I mean?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon knows! Sorush wants us to teach him a lesson!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No way! Only Paimon can be your best friend!
